summary: Server fallback timer for a death animation that never reports its end (born with character deaths in 'spells-1' and dialogue fights). Written by esv::death::CharacterSystem.

fields.name: Timer
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2BAB330 (called from the per-frame update of esv::death::CharacterSystem) adds or fetches the component (creator FUN_142bac930, 4 bytes, default 0) and sets it to 4.0 (0x40800000); later it subtracts delta time scaled by the entity time factor and at <= 0 fires FUN_142bada70 (the fallback-finished event, cf. esv::death::AnimFallbackTimerFinishedEventOneFrameComponent).
